isRentor(address).notice: Check if user is a rentor (vehicle owner)

isTokenBound(address).notice: Checks if a specific token is bound to this Identity Registry

isVerified(address).notice: Checks if a user is verified in the identity registry

registerIdentity(address,address,uint16).notice: Registers an identity for a user with a specified country

removeAgent(address).notice: Removes an agent from authorized identity management

setComplianceRules(address,address).notice: Sets the Compliance Rules module contract address

setInvestorTypeRegistry(address).notice: Sets the Investor Type Registry contract address

unbindIdentityRegistry(address).notice: Unbinds the Identity Registry from a specific token

updateCountry(address,uint16).notice: Updates the country associated with a user
